title: Case Management Advanced - Quiz
description: Test your understanding of advanced case management concepts in PEGA

questions.question: What is the primary benefit of parent-child case patterns?
options: Modeling complex business processes with related cases
questions.explanation: Parent-child case patterns allow you to model complex business processes where multiple related cases must be managed together while maintaining their individual lifecycles.

questions.question: In sequential parent-child processing, when are child cases triggered?
options: In a specific sequence based on business logic
questions.explanation: Sequential parent-child processing triggers child cases in a specific sequence based on business logic, ensuring proper workflow dependencies are maintained.

questions.question: How do child cases inherit properties from parent cases?
options: Via inheritance and data propagation mechanisms
questions.explanation: Child cases inherit properties from parent cases through inheritance and data propagation mechanisms that maintain data consistency while allowing child-specific overrides.

questions.question: What is the purpose of case relationships in advanced case management?
options: To define dependencies and ensure proper sequencing
questions.explanation: Case relationships define dependencies between cases to ensure proper sequencing, prevent race conditions, and maintain data integrity across related cases.

questions.question: When implementing case transfers, what is the most important consideration?
options: Maintaining case data integrity and audit trails
questions.explanation: Case transfers must maintain case data integrity and provide complete audit trails to ensure business continuity and regulatory compliance.

questions.question: How should case escalation be handled in complex scenarios?
options: Through automated escalation rules and approval workflows
questions.explanation: Case escalation should be handled through automated escalation rules and approval workflows that ensure consistent handling based on business priorities and SLAs.

questions.question: What is the key benefit of performance optimization in case management?
options: Improved user experience and system efficiency
questions.explanation: Performance optimization improves user experience through faster case processing and increases system efficiency by optimizing resource usage and database queries.

questions.question: What mechanism prevents race conditions in case dependencies?
questions.explanation: Proper sequencing and dependency management prevent race conditions by ensuring cases are processed in the correct order and data dependencies are respected.
